description: Use this when someone wants to know how many gallons (or litres, cubic feet) a swimming pool holds from its shape and size: rectangle, round, oval, Roman, Grecian, kidney, L-shape or freeform, with one depth, a shallow and a deep end, or an above-ground wall height (48, 52, 54 in). Dimensions in feet or metres. Returns gallons, litres, cubic feet, cubic metres, surface area and the formula. Use it before chemical_dose, pump_size or heater_size when only dimensions are known.

above_ground_wall_in.description: Above-ground round or oval pool: wall height in inches instead of depths.

deep_depth.description: Water depth at the deep end (optional; average of the two is used).

area.description: free: surface area in sq ft (or m² with unit m).

corner.description: grecian: size of each 45° corner cut (optional).

length.description: rect, oval, roman, grecian, kidney, lshape.

widthA.description: kidney: width of the wide end.

widthB.description: kidney: width of the narrow end.

shallow_depth.description: Water depth at the shallow end, or the only depth for a constant-depth pool.

shape.description: rect (default), round, oval, roman (half-circle ends), grecian (cut corners), kidney, lshape, free (freeform, needs area).

unit.description: Unit of every dimension and depth: ft (default) or m.

name: pool_volume

link.description: Page of calculatepool.com for the same calculation.

title: Pool volume in gallons
